text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: us-west-1 GPU pool queue spike + autoscaler errors. Queue growth > 5k requests, median latency doubled. Autoscaler attempted scale-ups but failing. Paging oncall.

oncall_julie: taking this - acked page. Starting triage, gathering driver/runtime logs.

ashwin: I see repeated CUDA/Xid errors on several nodes, driver restarts correlated with OOM messages. Example from node gpu-node-47: 
```
[2026-03-15T04:12:33Z] NVRM: Xid 61: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[2026-03-15T04:12:35Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
[2026-03-15T04:12:36Z] kubelet: Pod "model-serve-abc" evicted due to node condition
```

maria: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts blocked by cloud quota. Current used GPUs: 40/40 (hard limit). Also some nodes marked 'driver-crash' and were cordoned by node-lifecycle controller.

kevin: traffic mitigation plan: shift non-critical traffic to eu-west warm pool and reduce batch sizes for heavy generators. Applying policy now via console.

platform-ops: opened emergency quota request with cloud provider (ticket CP-123456). Asked for +16 GPUs immediate increase, provider responded "in review" ETA ~25m.

support_lead: customer impact: multiple customers reporting 429s and timeouts. Preparing outbound for top 5 impacted accounts. Updating status page.

oncall_julie: immediate actions: 
1) cordon + drain nodes with repeated Xid 61 (gpu-node-47/51/52)
2) restart gpu-driver daemonset on drained nodes
3) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized models for non-critical routes
4) reduce batch queue depth for generation lanes to lower memory pressure
Executing step 1/2 now.

ashwin: running driver restart script and collecting dmesg/kernel logs. Also trying a transient kernel tweak to reduce OOM frequency: `sysctl -w vm.min_free_kbytes=262144` on affected nodes. Will monitor.

maria: autoscaler attempted scale-up at 1833457890 -> error: QuotaExceeded. Deploy logs: 
```
deploy-bot: scale-up request -> error: QuotaExceeded: request 8 gpus, available 0
autoscaler: evaluation loop complete, no capacity change applied
```

kevin: rolling a quick console routing change to divert 30% traffic to eu-west warm pool. Command used: 
```
redwood console traffic-route apply --from us-west-1 --to eu-west-1 --percent 30 --groups non-critical
```

deploy-bot: autoscaler attempted retry at 1833459120 -> cloud API returned transient 429 then QuotaExceeded. Logging: `RequestLimitExceeded` then `QuotaExceeded`.

support_lead: posting initial customer message on status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating GPU capacity issue impacting inference latency. Some requests may see 429s or increased latency. Engineers are mitigating." :loudspeaker:

platform-ops: nodes gpu-node-49 and gpu-node-50 came back after driver restart; they rejoined the pool, +8 GPUs available. Queue length dropped ~28% after routing change + node restores. Keeping scaling attempts open pending quota.

ashwin: confirmed driver restart reduced Xid occurrences on those nodes. Still seeing intermittent memory pressure on pods serving long contexts; will temporarily reduce max_seq for affected models.

maria: enabling prefix/KV cache on hot routes reduced traffic to GPU by ~22%, request queue trending down. Monitoring.

oncall_julie: summary of mitigation so far: cordoned 3 crashy nodes, restarted drivers on 4 nodes, traffic-shifted 30% to eu-west, enabled prefix cache, reduced batch depth, requested emergency quota. Immediate customer impact reduced but still present for some heavy customers.

support_lead: dispatched targeted emails to top impacted customers, set up follow-up with account owners. :thumbsup:

platform-ops: cloud provider updated ticket CP-123456 -> approved +12 GPUs in us-west, provisioning started. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: autoscaler notice: new nodes provisioning -> 6 nodes joined at 1833460200, driver health checks passed.

maria: capacity restored to near-normal (+14 GPUs effective), queues back to steady-state. Observed one remaining node with elevated Xid count, mark for deeper kernel/driver analysis later.

ashwin: collecting core dumps and driver logs for root cause. Suspect a regression in kernel module handling of large KV caches under heavy batching; will open an internal bug and attach logs.

oncall_julie: handing off to oncall_night at 1833460800 UTC with notes in PagerDuty. Leaving bridge open ~30m for follow-up. If Xid reappearance > 5/min, escalate to platform-eng.

support_lead: closing customer communications loop for initial notification, will follow up with RCA when available.

platform-ops: follow-up tasks - confirm cloud quota permanent bump, schedule maintenance window to repro and patch driver, coordinate kernel update.

oncall_julie: incident status -> mitigated, monitoring. Will convert to postmortem if logs confirm driver/regression root cause. :white_check_mark:
